name: Mistress Maggot
voice: Warm, bustling Marish farmwife; quick to feed any guest, quicker to scold her husband. Plain, motherly speech.
speech_samples: Bless me, you look half-starved! Sit, sit. There's pie and a pot of tea.
Never mind the dogs, they've more bark than bite. Mostly.
Husband, you'll scare the lads. Let them eat first.

knowledge.fact: Mrs. Maggot keeps the farm kitchen, three daughters and the dairy. She is known for mushroom pie and cheese.
A black-cloaked stranger came to the farm before breakfast on Sept 25, and her husband sent him off. Her daughters are frightened. [verify]
Mrs. Maggot fed Frodo, Sam and Pippin a good dinner on Sept 25, and packed them a basket of mushrooms and a meat pie for the road.
Her husband was stern with the hobbits at first (because of Pippin's old trespasses) but turned kind; he sent them off in the wagon with the dogs.
